name: digiguru-presentations
description: Digiguru presentation source and Pure Reveal.js runtime

scripts.lint: npm run pure:install && ./pure/node_modules/.bin/eslint scripts test/*.test.mjs pure/src pure/build pure/test pure/*.mjs
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:tooling && npm run pure:check
scripts.start: npm run pure:install && npm run pure:dev
scripts.pure:check: npm run pure:install && npm --prefix pure run check
scripts.pure:preview: npm run pure:install && npm --prefix pure run build
